Resources

All known mineable resources across surveyed systems, grouped by type. Supported Power is the mining power a deposit accepts right now — a ship's summed mining-module power must stay below it (floor of remaining ÷ 20), so it falls as the deposit is worked. Max Amount is the deposit's capacity when the server has reported it; ~ marks an estimate (the highest remaining seen for that resource). Fauna sighted on the same surveys is on the Wildlife page.
